name: closed-review-kept
means: eyes consume never rewrites a review a completed run recorded at its close (reviewed.wrote): the packet names the review that was latest when it was bound (source.review), and consume appends to the latest review only while that is the bound review, or an eyes review of it (an eyes-of key equal to it), and no completed run recorded it at close; otherwise it writes a new review that names the bound one in eyes-of (null for a packet bound to none), sorts after the latest, keeps the latest's since and head and carries every charge open there once — so a close review stays as its run closed it and the open set loses nothing.
